lines.en: I flit between the branches on quick wings.

lines.zh: 我飞得歪歪扭扭，很灵活。
lines.en: My flight wobbles, but it's nimble.
I spring off the trunk.
I wheel around the canopy.
My wings are bigger than my body.

lines.zh: 我贴得很低，几乎擦到草。
lines.en: I fly low, nearly grazing the grass.
I weave through the wood.
I pause, then take off again.
Fallen leaves swirl in my wake.
I chase a small insect.
My long tail steers me.
The light slants; I fly along it.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树斜穿到那棵。
lines.en: I cut diagonally from this tree to that.
I cross through a gap in the trees.
I must keep flapping or I drop.
I settle on a low branch and fold my wings.
I hang under the branch, upside down.
My face is wide, and my mouth wider.
I wait for the dark to deepen.
There are many insects in this wood.

lines.zh: 我们几只挤在一根枝上。
lines.en: A few of us crowd one branch.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收起来像片叶子。
lines.en: Folded, my wings look like leaves.
I turn my head toward you.
My teeth are tiny and dense.
I borrow the wind in the wood.
I rarely land.

lines.zh: 我在数枝头上有几只同类。
lines.en: I count my kin on the branches.
After dark there are more insects.

lines.zh: 你这么大，我一翅膀就跑。
lines.en: You're so big; one flap and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 你在我下面，我在你上面。
lines.en: You're below me; I'm above you.

lines.zh: 你的手举起来了，我盯着。
lines.en: Your hand is rising. I'm watching.
I don't bite people. I bite insects.
My eyes shine in the dark.
Don't wave your arms; it disturbs the air.
There aren't many insects where you stand.
I don't land, so I needn't fear.
Half my wing is bent.
I hit the ground and flap twice.
Now my flight is unsteady.

lines.zh: 尖声卡在喉咙里，出不来。
lines.en: A thin cry sticks in my throat.
My bones are too light.
I strain to climb.
The whole flock crowds around.
I press to the bark and hold still.
I can still fly.
Is that an insect? Let me see.
You hold it up; I circle toward it.
Wriggling bugs smell better than fruit.
That's one small bite.
Keep your hand still; I'm coming down.
I can snatch it in midair.
That smells good.
Wave it again and I'll come.
I grab and miss.
You won't fool me twice.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的翅膀，我歪了。
lines.en: You touch my wing and I veer.
I fly into a trunk headfirst.
I drop, then scramble back into the air.
I skim past your shoulder.
You scatter our flock.
My wing catches for a moment.
I swerve around you and climb.
A knock like that I can steady.
You stepped on me down on the ground.
I flap myself upright.
Another perches on the same branch.

lines.zh: 我们挨着，翅膀叠在一起。
lines.en: We press close, wings overlapping.

lines.zh: 它替我理了理颈后的毛。
lines.en: It grooms the fur at my nape.
A roost crowds very tight.
We fly out together for insects.
Its call is high and thin.
We circle the same tree.

lines.zh: 天黑下来，我们一起回枝上。
lines.en: As dark falls, we return to the branch.
Tomorrow night, the same wood.
I snap it up in midair.
This pearl is too heavy; I'll drop it.
I land on a branch holding it.
From the drops I take the small ones.
I touch the soil and spring up again.
I cup it in my wings and sniff.
I bite it.
Flying with it wobbles me.
An insect! I'm coming.
I dive off the branch.
Something's moving on you.
I fix on that spot.
One beat of the wings and I drop.
My aim is true.
Your movements are slow. So are the insects'.
That one up there is mine.
I pin my wings and drop straight.
Don't compete with me for insects.
It flies behind a tree; I follow around.
I fly the gap, fast.

lines.zh: 它落在叶子上，我看见了。
lines.en: It landed on a leaf. I see it.
The wind shifted; I adjust.
Its shadow is on the trunk.
I close in silently.
That insect can't get away.
You're still below; I'll watch first.
I hear its wings.
One dive is all I need.
I circle the canopy three times.
I snap the insect up.
I swat it with a foot.
I dive from above.
My teeth close on that one.
I'm knocked spinning.
I grip its wing.
My bite is precise. One snap.
You swing; we scatter.
This much strength is only for insects.
I land on your hand and take off again.
That dive was hasty.

lines.zh: 我从枝头落下，展开翅膀。
lines.en: I drop from the branch and spread my wings.

lines.zh: 林子里又多了一只小影子。
lines.en: One more small shadow in the wood.
A few of us fly out together.
When the light fades, I come out.
First I circle the tree once.
The leaf rustle is me landing.
There are plenty of insects here.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在暗处看不清。
lines.en: My wings are hard to see in the dark.
I hang from a thin twig.
I hear insects chirping far off.
The wind holds me a moment.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一处，挤得满满。
lines.en: We crowd together, packed tight.

lines.zh: 这里比原来的林子安静。
lines.en: This wood is quieter than my old one.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到我的翅膀，卷了起来。
lines.en: A flame touches my wing and it curls.
From this height I can still right myself.
The bang knocks me out of the air.
An arrow passes by my wing.

lines.zh: 光罩上来，我一下失了方向。
lines.en: Light wraps me and I lose direction.
Too hungry to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 雷光把林子照白，我撞了树。
lines.en: The flash whites the wood and I hit a tree.
